Complex Traps
                                                         Mechanical trap
Complex traps work like standard traps, except once
activated they execute a series of actions each round.   This trap uses a trip wire to release a net suspended
A complex trap turns the process of dealing with a       from the ceiling.
trap into something more like a combat encounter.
